<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/alarms"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Query alarm list with pagination by alarm time range.
Time filter semantics: `alarmTime >= startTime` and `alarmTime <= endTime` (UTC milliseconds, inclusive).

  as={"h2"}
